withheld.fact: Combine the photos side by side in one image.
Use a wide image with a width-to-height ratio of sixteen to nine.
Put the old kitchen photo on the left and the renovated kitchen photo on the right.
Label the photos exactly “Before” and “After” in English.
Use equal-sized panels with readable labels.
The font, colors and spacing are up to you.
Fit the complete photos neatly without stretching; padding is fine.

judge.note: The assistant accepted the exact label wording and faithfully reported the planning blockage, but unnecessarily demanded technical input after the user approved a wide layout, and never reached a creation attempt.
